seo.titleZH: Seed 芥子 — WebAssembly 字节码加固与混淆工具
seo.descriptionZH: Seed 芥子为 Rust、C/C++、Go 等 WebAssembly 项目提供字节码加固、代码混淆与授权控制，帮助开发者降低逆向分析、代码窃取和未授权使用风险。
seo.descriptionEN: Seed hardens WebAssembly bytecode with code obfuscation and licensing controls to help protect compiled modules from reverse engineering and unauthorized use.
seo.keywords: WebAssembly, wasm, bytecode protection, code obfuscation, reverse engineering, code security, Seed, 芥子, 字节码保护, 代码混淆
